Elemental (Earth) · SM -3 Earth Elemental (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5, SRD 5.1)

A squat body of interlocked slate, granite and ochre clay, with a boulder for a head and blunt fists in place of hands. It walks through solid rock as easily as a person walks through a doorway, and it hits like the wall it stepped out of.
